rows.grounds: instrumental of mūla; by the root

items.question: How does Śrī Tripurā become the pervading fifteen-fold light after being made by the root?
items.inference: root-caused pervasion yields Tripurā as fifteen-fold light
items.plain_english: Having made pervading by the root, oneself becomes Śrī Tripurā; fifteen-fold light.
